remarks: Exceptional opportunity to acquire a parcel in the highly sought-after Pacific Palisades community. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, the property offers a chance to envision and build a new home in a desirable coastal setting. Just minutes from the beach, Palisades Village, and the area's renowned outdoor recreation, the location offers coastal living with convenient access to neighborhood amenities. A compelling opportunity for builders, developers, investors, or end users looking to establish a presence in Pacific Palisades and explore rebuilding possibilities.
